title: The Default tag follows the shop's own term when it is the default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, set as the default for new customers.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps: 1. Look at the term A row's Name cell.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • It reads term A's name followed directly by a "Default" tag (no info or lock icon).
  • COD shows its info and lock icons and no "Default" tag.
  • Term A is the only row with the tag.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R11: “The shop's default term shows a "Default" tag after its name (after the info and lock icons for COD and Due on Receipt). Exactly one row carries the tag.”
  • S1-R10: “No other term (standard Net terms and every term the shop created) shows an info icon or a lock icon.”
